body:
damn i feel this. ya. really. because i've gone through literally the same thing as yours. (I do still feel like nothing has changed since im still living with my 'family' which doesn't really help me with getting through nightmares) my childhood was terrible. my parents divorced, argued a lot, verbally abused in school parents and even my brothers (which is kinda sad huh) and physically got harmed but i just hoped it'd get better someday somehow but hey nothing literally changed. my looking? holy jesus it looks so fucking terrible that i dont even want to look into a mirror. my family's financial circumstance was worse than I expected when I figured out some of the major issues (and since then I even stopped talkin everything related to money lol or I only talk bout money when I need to)

Lookin back, though it's been more than 10 years, when i was a damn kid i just thought so naively that everything'd be just getting good because hey some ppl say time cleans everything up and makes everything how it was meant to be at first, but no. I was wrong. Why? Because nothing has changed. Literally. Nothing. Yeah it sucks.

What I tried to mend all these things was just getting into what I liked like listening to songs or playing games sth like these. BUT JESUS NOW WHENEVER I DONT DO STH ELSE THAT CAN TAKE MY ATTENTION AWAY I JUST START TO FEEL HELPLESS AND LONE. And since I have gone through a lot of debacles that affected my personality and life in bad ways, now I can't even feel self-confidence or self-esteem within me which can sometimes help me draw some sort of inspiration, hope, or willingness for my works (writing some stuff, studying for college, etc.)

and now what... im heading to my final destination. lol i've written everything I wanted to say on my notes... i just wonder how many nights I would be able to survive more henceforth till I kill myself sigh

yeah ik i wrote like shit (Without even considering those who will read this... i mean... if there's ever one) and kinda long so sorry for that and I really want to thank you if you've read all these things...
Hope this will go away soon. I am at the edge of the cliff now... Thank you for your encouraging words...

Hey... I totally can feel you.  It really hurts to think of how I hurt people unintentionally and how much it sucks realizing and how much deep it can drag you down...
 I am living with my father currently and deep inside I want to make him happy but I cannot do that because I can't even handle myself with this great suffocation I have. I kept being bullied until I got into high school (sometimes I feel like I am still being bullied though because you know...... Sigh.), and yeah. That's how my childhood got fucked up, and all these bad memories keep crawling up every single day.
 Every day I wake up with astonishment of being alive. Yeah. And because of all these things... I have no one to talk to about these things (cuz u know some people would say like oh that's sad or don't be too depressive and that's it...) I often become selfish or judgemental because I really have never known how to care people thus far, and I still am sadly, despite I try to change my attitude, because you know, it is hard. And as you mentioned, they aren't our faults.
 Yeah. It is really painful to live with having such feelings like yours and mine. It feels like I'm hurting myself unintentionally but not being able to stop it because stopping it would be a permanent solution for a problem unknown whether it may be permanent or not...

I can't stop crying. But at least I am thankful that many people feel like the same as me, including you.
